//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Brand New Day -> Config

Enable Brand New Day.//: Whether Brand New Day is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

showHeader.//: If the header image should be shown at the top of the new day screen.

showDayCount.//: If the current day number should be shown on the new day screen.

showStats.//: If a summary of the previous day should be shown. Each line can be toggled individually below.

playSound.//: If a sound plays when the new day screen appears.

newDayScreenDurationTicks.//: How many ticks the new day screen stays on screen in total. 20 ticks = 1 second. min: 1, max: 1,200

newDayScreenFadeInTicks.//: How many ticks the screen takes to fade in. 20 ticks = 1 second. min: 1, max: 200

newDayScreenFadeOutTicks.//: How many ticks the screen takes to fade out before disappearing. 20 ticks = 1 second. min: 1, max: 200

guiScaleModifier.//: Scales the day number, stats text, and header image together, based on the player's GUI scale. 1.0 matches the configured sizes at GUI scale 4; higher makes everything bigger. min: 0.1, max: 5

headerImageWidth.//: The width in pixels the header image is rendered at on screen. min: 0, max: 2,000

headerImageHeight.//: The height in pixels the header image is rendered at on screen. min: 0, max: 2,000

headerImageYOffset.//: How far down from the top of the screen the header image is drawn, in pixels. 0 is flush against the top. min: 0, max: 1,000

dayFontScale.//: How much bigger the day number text should be rendered. 1 is the normal font size. min: 1, max: 8

dayTextRGB.//: The colour of the day number text, as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.

showMobsKilled.//: If the monsters slain line is shown in the day summary.

showBlocksBroken.//: If the blocks broken line is shown in the day summary.

showDistanceTraveled.//: If the distance traveled line is shown in the day summary.

showDeaths.//: If the deaths line is shown in the day summary.

showItemsCrafted.//: If the items crafted line is shown in the day summary.

statsKeyTextRGB.//: The colour of the stat labels (the key text), as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.

statsValueTextRGB.//: The colour of the stat values (the numbers), as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.
